commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
{T}, Sacrifice an artifact: Bjorna, Nightfall Alchemist deals 1 damage to target creature. Goad that creature. (Until your next turn, that creature attacks each combat if able and attacks a player other than you if able.)
Partner—Friends forever (You can have two commanders if both have this ability.)

Your maximum hand size is eleven.
Whenever Cecily, Haunted Mage attacks, you draw a card and you lose 1 life. Then if you have eleven or more cards in your hand, you may cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.
Partner—Friends forever (You can have two commanders if both have this ability.)

source_basis.known_approval_project_exceptions: Explicit user approval of Reckless Fireweaver to Robe of the Archmagi; Lutri companion plus Trade Secrets and Yawgmoth's Bargain preserved as documented project exceptions; fresh retrospective gate completed 2026-10-14.

strategy.primary: Big-hand spells: draw to eleven-plus cards with Rhystic Study, The One Ring, wheels and Trade Secrets/Yawgmoth's Bargain, attack with Cecily to draw and cast an instant or sorcery free, and win with draw-based combos (Peer into the Abyss + Psychosis Crawler or Teferi's Ageless Insight, Underworld Breach + Wheel of Fortune + Jeska's Will).
strategy.secondary: Bjorna sacrifices spare artifacts (Treasures, Thopters, Clues) to deal 1 damage to and goad an opposing creature: the ping kills X/1s, and goad gives defensive and political value on opponents' turns (the creature must attack a player other than Bjorna's controller if able). Goad sets attack requirements only; it doesn't stop a creature from blocking, so it doesn't clear blockers for Cecily.

role.advances_plan: Cecily (significant) turns attacks into a card and, with 11+ cards, a free spell. Bjorna (supporting/incidental) is a small repeatable ping/goad that uses artifact tokens: it kills X/1s and redirects attacks on opponents' turns. As a pair they are supporting; the deck wins with draw-and-wheel combos that don't need either commander.
role.honest_note: The source blueprint misdescribes both commanders (Bjorna does not grant haste on noncreature spells; Cecily triggers on attacking, not combat damage; M1 bjorna-12). On current Oracle Bjorna is close to incidental and Cecily is a significant but combat-exposed engine. The approval dossier calls the pair the 'strategic center'; GrokBot's reading is that the draw/wheel/Peer package is.

identity_core.why: Attack draw and free spell at eleven cards: the pair's real engine.
Required partner: 1 damage kills an X/1, and goad pushes an opponent's creature to attack someone else on their turn. Goad doesn't stop blocking.
Central combo piece and the biggest single hand-size swing.
Protection plus escalating draw toward eleven.
Project-authorized exception that fuels the hand-size plan.
